card.name: Digit 5 or 6 inside ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: The single digits 5 or 6 early in a multi-digit number, most strongly inside ISBN codes in book citations. It also fires weakly on 5 within figures like 1,500 or 1.57.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: A 5 or 6 digit inside an ISBN in a book reference.

modes.label: Digit in other numbers
modes.description: A 5 after a comma or decimal point in doses, counts or statistics.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on a 5 or 6 in the middle of a long number, mainly book ISBN codes.
